description: Save the current search as a named alert. The user will receive email digests when new matching listings appear. Requires authentication.

filters.description: The structured filter map to persist (same shape as search_listings filters).

name.description: A human-readable name for the saved search. If omitted, a name is derived from the filters.

query.description: The free-text query string, if any.

name: save_search
title: Save search
